response.answer: Adenosine A2A receptor signaling in choroid plexus regulates CSF secretion; PI3K/AKT and SPAK pathways influence this process. Istradefylline, an A2AR antagonist, shows potential in treating hydrocephalus by modulating these pathways. Drug repurposing of A2AR antagonists may offer new treatment strategies for ventriculomegaly.
